findings.detail: invokeNative now categorizes ramwarm.exe as ram_warm but directLaunchCounts lacks ram_warm:0. The synchronous helper self-test increments undefined to NaN. The asynchronous launcher sees an existing property and preserves NaN; numericMapJSON serializes NaN as an unquoted JSON token.
findings.minimal_fix: Initialize ram_warm:0 in directLaunchCounts, or normalize any missing per-kind counter before invokeNative increments it; preserve the change in the assembler.
findings.verified_resolution: native_runner.js line48 initializes ram_warm:0; assemble_runtime.py lines48-49 preserve this replacement.

findings.detail: shutdownComplete means the drain attempt has completed and is true for the idempotent false result with live or uncertain workers. Mapping it to owned_worker_shutdown_complete reports completed worker shutdown even while the retained lock protects surviving workers.
findings.minimal_fix: Bind owned_worker_shutdown_complete to shutdownClean, or expose distinct shutdown_attempt_complete and shutdown_clean fields with accurate meanings.
findings.verified_resolution: native_runner.js line1876 binds owned_worker_shutdown_complete to shutdownClean; assemble_runtime.py line71 preserves this replacement.

ramwarm.exe is included in assertNoLockWorkers relevant-process regex; invokeNative routing exists, with the counter-initialization finding above.
processModulesParallel completes ordinary terminal states before failure/blocked gate and finalAudit. No aggregate launches on failed or blocked ordinary modules.
Final audit is followed by successful WORKER_SHUTDOWN before axiom/mathematical/project/run PASS markers and successful result serialization.
ram_warm_status reads the final parallelRuntime.ramStatus; ram_warm_exit_code emits null or the actual recorded integer. Shutdown refreshes these before success or failure result writing.
Catch records failure; lock-held tail invokes parallelShutdown, writes failure result, and releases only if its return is true. Early failures before lock ownership do not attempt lock release.
A false pre-PASS shutdown causes failure; the tail receives the same false result without another drain and retains the lock.
